title: Purpose
bodyHtml:
Watch the original video

Purpose is the fourth fundamental development area of The Circle Blueprint—which you may have read, but which is not entirely essential. There are also workbooks for the other three fundamental development areas (Independence, Humility, and Power), and you may wish to also work through the other three after you work through the Purpose Workbook to more fully develop your Circle Blueprint. The system in this workbook is intended for anyone with an interest in developing a higher mastery of the element of Purpose. People who develop a mastery of Purpose have a clear understanding of how to deploy the gifts they have in life in the most useful manner.  

Six Factors Affect Our Ability to Gain Purpose:

  1. Resolute: Clearly knowing your destination before your start your journey, thoughtfully determining your progress, and the ability to choose wisely.
  2. Diligence: Deliberately and persistently acting in pursuit of a goal.
  3. Myopia: Inflexible, closed-minded thinking.
  4. Experience Sharing: How we communicate events to others.
  5. Self-Deception: The act of misleading oneself.
  6. Spirituality: Seeing that life is much bigger and more complex than what is material.

The Circle Blueprint provides in-depth explanations of these factors, but this overview should give you a gist of it, and the results of your assessment, or even honest self-reflection on these issues, will let you know where you may need further development or better balance.  

Specifically, the assessment results provide descriptions on our “Thriving Scale.” On each factor, you should have a score.   

  • I am hanging on by my fingernails. Despite all I have accomplished, my life isn’t good at all.
  • I am eroding. I’m not desperate but my life is a grind and does not seem to be headed in a positive direction.
  • I am treading water and just sort of enduring my situation. My life isn’t bad, but I would not say it is good, either.
  • I am growing. My life is on a positive trajectory. Certainly, it could be better, but I am reasonably satisfied and optimistic about the future.
  • I am thriving. I am creatively engaged in my work and life. I am at the top of my game. I feel energized, balanced, healthy, and happy.

Introduction to Humility

Humility is the third of four fundamental development areas of The Circle Blueprint—which you may have read, but which is not entirely essential. There are also workbooks for the other three fundamental development areas (Independence, Power, and Purpose), and you may wish to also work through the first two in order and then move onto the final one after completing the Humility Workbook to fully develop your Circle Blueprint. The system in this workbook is intended for anyone with an interest in developing a higher mastery of the element of Humility. People who develop a mastery of Humility have an accurate view of their qualities and skills but keep their benefits and drawbacks in perspective.

Humility Consists of Five Factors:

  1. Modesty: Lacking the need to have your accomplishments seen or valued by others.
  2. Narcissism: Preoccupation with being and feeling superior to others.
  3. Self-Monitoring: Being able to see oneself as he or she truly is and understanding how to effectively interact with others.  
  4. Self-Esteem: Having a level of regard for oneself.
  5. Tolerance: Being able to accept oneself and others as well as the situation one is in.

Meet Gladys… the Turtle

Over the years, I have brought the coaching principles I have learned to executives and high performing teams.  However, these principles are universal and benefit everyone who is interested, which inspired me to write my first children’s book.

This is the story of Gladys, who as a young turtle never considered the need for a shell.  She loved jumping rope, playing in the stream and dancing.

title: The Circle Blueprint
bodyHtml:
What is the Circle Blueprint System?

The Circle Blueprint is a program you can use at your own pace to strengthen areas of weakness, cultivate new capabilities and discover new possibilities for your life.

It starts simply with The Circle Blueprint book which awakens you to examining and cultivating the greatest asset we have…our uniqueness.

We complement the book with a free in-depth Assessment to identify those areas in your life that can be improved as well as offer a series of workbooks to empower you in the areas that need it most.

Joining the Circle Blueprint Community provides the opportunity to be part of a group of people like yourself who want to expand their lives and support each other in the process. Remember, you are your most important asset.

   

Your Path to Aliveness:

“We all struggle with trying to have it all. While we may appear to be doing well, just beneath the surface we are struggling with unhealthy relationships with family, friends, work, money, self-esteem… you name it. We somehow thought all this success would feel different. We thought we would be happier.

If you are ready to stop confusing activity with progress and break the conscious and unconscious habits and patterns that hold you hostage to a life that isn’t working for you, take this assessment and read this book. It will force you to take off your biased, rose-colored glasses and require you to be honest with yourself on the changes you need to make. then, it will give you the tools you need to make those changes.

The whole process is broken into simple, achievable steps. I’ve read hundreds of self-help and leadership books. None of them touch the comprehensive and practical nature of this program. There’s a life out there that isn’t filled with emptiness, frustration and disappointment…and it’s yours if you want it!”

–Shane Goodwill

 

This scientifically validated psychometric self-assessment tool reveals your inherent personality traits as they pertain to the concepts in the book. It tells you exactly where you fall on a “mastery” spectrum in the book’s four developmental areas—unearthing exactly where you are limiting your greatness.

This is the self-awareness piece that truly sparks change and pushes you to move toward balance, wholeness, and a life in which you thrive. By the way, your results are 100 percent confidential, so you can feel free to be completely honest when you answer the questions.

title: FAQs
bodyHtml:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Answers to commonly asked questions about The Roadmap. Additional questions? Please contact Dr. Skeen in the Contact page.

The Roadmap

What is the Roadmap?

The Roadmap is a meticulously crafted process designed to help individuals discover their own unique genius and tap into their true potential. Guided by executive coach Dr. Jack Skeen, this transformative journey combines advanced 3D personality assessments, in-depth one-on-one interviews, and expert analysis and guidance. It's designed to enable individuals to uncover their strengths, values, and passions, providing a powerful catalyst for personal/professional growth and change. Whether you're an executive, a business leader, or anyone striving for personal excellence, the Roadmap can help guide you toward greater purpose, success, and fulfillment. It's not just a program; it's a life-altering experience that helps you discover your brilliance and navigate your path to becoming extraordinary.

How does the Roadmap process work?

The Roadmap process consists of an in-depth process of self-discovery and expert guidance. It begins with comprehensive advanced 3D personality assessments, and includes in-depth one-on-one interviews, as well as expert analysis and guidance. These insights are then synthesized into a detailed, personalized report, providing clarity and guidance on how to unlock your true potential. This isn't a one-size-fits-all approach; it's tailored specifically to you. The program integrates extensive personal interviews, discussions with stakeholders, and expert recommendations, ensuring that your journey toward personal and professional growth is well-informed and impactful.

What can I expect from the Roadmap program?

While everyone experiences the process differently, you can anticipate a profound sense of discovery, and resulting transformation in your personal and professional life. You will gain an in-depth understanding of your unique strengths, values, and passions, providing clarity and direction. This newfound self-awareness empowers you to make informed decisions and set meaningful goals. By the end of the Roadmap process, you'll have not only a clearer path forward but also the knowledge and confidence to navigate it successfully. It's a transformative experience designed to help you realize your brilliance and achieve extraordinary results. For some, the Roadmap has been truly life-changing.

Who is the Roadmap program designed for?

The Roadmap program is tailored to individuals who are committed to their personal and professional growth. It is ideal for executives, leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, and anyone striving for excellence. Whether you're at the pinnacle of your career or just beginning your journey, the Roadmap is designed to help you discover and unlock your unique genius. Think of the Roadmap as a compass to guide you toward greater fulfillment, purpose, and personal growth, regardless of where you are in your life's journey, It's a valuable resource for individuals who are ready to invest in their own potential.

I've been successful in my career, but I still don't feel fully satisfied. Can the Roadmap program help me find the purpose and fulfillment I'm seeking?

Absolutely. The Roadmap is designed for individuals like you who have achieved success in their careers, but are seeking greater fulfillment and purpose. Many high-achieving professionals find themselves at a crossroads, looking to align their accomplishments with their deeper passions and values. The Roadmap is a personalized journey that helps you gain a profound understanding of your unique strengths and desires. It empowers you to make informed decisions, set meaningful goals, and unlock your true potential. By the end of the process, you'll have a clear path forward, a sense of purpose, and the insight to achieve a new level of personal fulfillment. It's a transformative experience for those who want to ensure that their achievements align with their inner aspirations.

What is the cost of the Roadmap program?

The Roadmap program is an investment in your personal and professional growth, and the cost is $15,000. This investment reflects the personalized nature of the coaching and the dedication of Dr. Jack Skeen to your journey. The program's cost covers the in-depth personality assessments, one-on-one interviews, expert guidance, and the development of your personalized roadmap. It's important to remember that this investment isn't just in a program--but rather an investment in yourself, your future, and your path to greater success and fulfillment. The return on investment is often profound, as the program equips one with the tools and insights needed to make life-changing decisions, set meaningful goals, and achieve breakthrough personal and professional growth.

How long does the Roadmap program last?

The duration of the Roadmap program can vary depending on the schedule and unique needs of each individual participant. Typically, the program spans a couple of months to allow for a comprehensive and effective experience. The process is designed to provide ample time for in-depth assessments, one-on-one interviews, feedback, and the development of your personalized roadmap. The goal is to ensure that you have a transformative and impactful journey towards personal and professional growth. The exact duration will be discussed and determined during the initial stages of the program, as it is essential that the program is aligned with your specific needs, schedule and personal objectives.

Is the Roadmap program available to international clients?

Yes, the Roadmap is accessible to English-speaking clients worldwide. The program is designed to accommodate individuals regardless of their geographic location. With the flexibility of virtual sessions and interviews, you can participate in the program from anywhere across the world.

Are there examples of success stories from the Roadmap?

Certainly, we have a wonderful collection of success stories from participants who have undergone the Roadmap program. These stories serve as powerful testimonials to the transformative potential of the program. They showcase the remarkable results achieved by individuals who have harnessed the Roadmap to unlock their true potential. Noted presidents, CEOs, and business leaders, including legendary investor and philanthropist Mohnish Pobrai have provided testimonials as to the transformative impact of the Roadmap. View them in the SUCCESS STORIES in the top menu. Reading and listening to these success stories (text and video) provides insight into the profound impact of the program and the personal life-changing experiences of others, in their own words.

Can I request a consultation or more information about the Roadmap program before enrolling?

Of course. We encourage people interested in the Roadmap to request a consultation or seek more information. We understand that you may have questions or require additional details to make an informed decision. To request a consultation or learn more, please contact us. We believe that every participant should have the opportunity to explore how the Roadmap program can align with their specific needs and objectives. Schedule a 15-minute consultation with Dr. Jack Skeen in the CONTACT page.

Are there any scholarships, discounts, or flexible payment options available for the Roadmap?

At this time, we do not offer scholarships for the Roadmap program. However, we understand that the program represents a financial commitment. To make it more accessible, we do provide flexible payment options and installment plans upon request. These options can help distribute the investment over time, making the program more manageable for participants who are committed to unlocking their full potential. Please contact us to discuss payment options and find a solution that aligns with your financial goals and personal growth journey.

title: Executive Coaching
bodyHtml:
EXECUTIVE COACHING

Intensive, one-on-one coaching is designed to create real, powerful and sustainable increases in leadership effectiveness and results.

Everyone who is committed to excellence needs a coach. Tiger Woods understood that his game would not improve without the assistance of someone who looked from the outside and was qualified to make suggestions that were not obvious to him.

Executives carry great responsibility to act for the welfare of their stakeholders, to see beyond the day-to-day activities and to optimize their positioning in the marketplace. With such rapid change in the economic landscape, the need for expanding skill sets and perspective is inescapable.

Business coaching services focus on assisting successful leaders to increase their effectiveness and expand their impact. It deals with issues such as:

• Identifying and removing obstacles to success
• Leading through inspiration
• Using time effectively
• Empowering through delegation
• Understanding and leveraging your genius and the genius of your people

• Minimizing drama in your life and workplace
• Quickly learning from feedback
• Resolving interpersonal conflict
• Learning how to create success
• Removing “upper limits”

Coaching is a confidential process that takes part in person and over the phone. It requires mutual initiation of issues, gracious insight, identification of actionable changes, and accountability.

Our goal is to equip leaders with the skills necessary to make a powerful and positive impact in the workplace and in the world.

Team Development

Optimizing communication, creativity and collaboration within business teams.

Today’s business relies heavily upon the efficacy of teams. Research clearly shows that decisions made by teams are consistently better than those made by individuals. Jack Welch said that those who see reality most clearly have the competitive advantage. Teams bring together multiple perspectives such that individual biases are reduced and the likelihood of seeing reality clearly dramatically increases.

The executive team of an international, Chicago-based manufacturing company was having difficulty making decisions. Issues were argued persistently as strong-willed people focused their energy on persuading and made little room for listening to one another. Learning new communication skills streamlined their debate and led to quicker, better decisions with greater support.

A sales team was unwilling to share information with one another, each person fearful of being “scooped” by his or her peer. Their resistance was limiting their ability to assist each other and to win bigger deals that required more collaboration. Assisting the team in developing a greater vision of success got them unstuck and opened the pathway to productive sharing of information.

We teach teams how to:

• Collaborate effectively, subjecting individual interests to create the group “win”
• Speak candidly with one another
• Expand creativity and idea generation
• Increase and demonstrate appreciation for one another
• Decrease drama within the team
• Create a clear vision of success
• Strategize effectively
• Focus on driving results collaboratively

These engagements involve an initial assessment of team function followed by an action plan.

Action plans involve:

• A half-day offsite for skill training
• A once per month 2-hour skill training program

Effective work teams will radically increase productivity and employee satisfaction. We can make a difference in your company by “tuning up” your teams.

Leadership Training

Enhancing the leadership skills and maturity of talented people within your organization.

High-potential employees are the lifeblood of your company’s stability and success. Attracting and retaining these talented employees is a critical success factor in today’s competitive marketplace. Unfortunately, mentoring and training these valuable resources often takes a back seat to daily business demands.

Leadership Training is a cost effective and potent investment in these high potential people. This program delivers an agenda for growth that seasons young leaders and prepares them for promotion within your organization.

The following components are included:

• A personalized feedback process that gathers thorough information on their current strengths and development needs through interviews with key people.
• Personality testing.
• Personal interviews.
• A comprehensive Development Plan that includes all of the preceding data and recommendations for key learning and skill development.
• Leadership coaching to ensure that the insights gained are actually put into concrete action.

This program is ideal for companies that do not have an “in-house” training and development program and who recognize the need to reward and invest in their high potential employees. Our goal is to equip these young leaders to make a powerful positive difference in your company and in the world.

The CEO of one of our client companies engaged in this process to check it out. He was impressed enough to roll it out to his direct reports. Now he has elected to invite four of their high-potential employees per quarter to participate in this program. His leaders are seeing new ways to add to their effectiveness; often beyond their formal job description. They are more excited, better focused and exerting more leadership. Feedback and results are so positive that they have made it a permanent part of their leadership development.

Culture Change

Every team and company has a culture. Your culture is the accumulation of the values and behaviors that define how you operate.  Cultures that develop without intentionality often include bad habits, we might call "sludge", that get in the way of progress. A few examples of sludge are drama, gossip and unresolved resentment.

Some teams and companies actually choose their culture. They decide on the specific values and behaviors will drive results and then consciously teach, measure, recognize and reward them. 

Dr. Skeen can assist you in defining your current culture, determining your preferred culture and then creating the plan to make the transition.  The right culture is a game-changer.

Roadmap

“Jack believes that every person has a special gift that he calls your “genius”. When you know your “genius” and align with it, work stops feeling burdensome. It becomes an expression of your creativity. It actually gives you energy and feeds your vitality.

He developed a process he calls your “Roadmap” to discover your “genius”. It includes personality testing, interviews with people who know you well and personal time with Jack and culminates in a lengthy report with clear guidance and specific recommendations for change.

Your “Roadmap” can change your life forever as many people have experienced.”

Contact Us
